name: Doodle World
desc: A wobbly hand-drawn landscape that draws itself stroke by stroke over a section then keeps boiling forever - hills, a rayed sun, a little house, a tree and dancing stick figures - rendered as graphite pencil, bold ink, waxy crayon, blueprint, chalkboard or neon scribble.

style.doc: medium: graphite / ink / crayon / blueprint schematic / chalkboard / neon glow

act.doc: dramaturgy: draw-once-and-hold / redraw loop / everything sways in wind
